newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-WALLABIES CONFIRM CHANGES FOR BLEDISLOE CUP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WALLABIES CONFIRM CHANGES FOR BLEDISLOE CUP.

text.p: Australia coach Greg Smith finalised his line-up for next week's Tri-Nations rugby union test against New Zealand on Sunday, making three changes to the team which defeated England 25-6 a week ago.
Props Richard Harry and Andrew Heath were recalled to the front row at the expense of Ewen MacKenzie and Cameron Blades. Number eight Michael Brial was chosen ahead of Troy Coker.

Smith had made no secret of the fact that he was unhappy with his team's scrummaging display against the English and had foreshadowed the changes by naming an expanded 23-man squad for Saturday's match at the Melbourne Cricket Ground.
Harry's return marks a rapid turnaround for the New South Wales forward, who was dumped after Australia's 30-13 loss to the All Blacks in the first Bledisloe Cup match in Christchurch 15 days ago.

Australia - 15-Matthew Burke, 14-Ben Tune, 13-Jason Little, 12-James Holbeck, 11-Joe Roff, 10-Tim Horan, 9-George Gregan, 8-Michael Brial, 7-Brett Robinson, 6-Daniel Manu, 5-Garrick Morgan, 4-John Eales (captain), 3-Richard Harry, 2-Michael Foley, 1-Andrew Heath.
